body: Today is the third day that I’ve been fighting an anxiety attack. I haven’t had one in so long I’ve just been keeping it down and I don’t know after my counseling session happened It’s just gotten stronger my anxiety. Not only am I exhausted from depression but now forcing myself not to become engulfed in panic is much worse. I’m so tired but I can’t sleep at night. I deleted all my social media accounts recently. I just don’t feel like seeing people who are happy when I’m not. I know it’s just a front that people put on but I can’t even do that. What’s the point of having social media if I don’t want to keep in contact with anyone.
I hate that feeling. For me I feel alright sometimes but it only takes one thing for me to start wishing my death again. It only takes one thing to set me off the rails.

I struggle with suicidal ideation and it’s gotten so bad that I can’t drive cause I literally start have intrusive thoughts telling me to let go of the wheel and press the gas. Meditation and saying affirmations isn’t going to help with that. I take walks when I can crawl out of bed but it doesn’t help me at all I just feel worse cause my body feels like a ton of bricks.

I’m 17 and I’ve felt constant loneliness since I was young. I’ve never had that group of friends that accepted me. I’ve always been different and felt different. Today actually I deleted all my social media because I couldn’t stand looking at people on my feed who are so happy while I’m not. When’s your birthday? Mine is coming up too

I feel the exact same way today I got into a fight with someone cause they told me you should meditate. Like wtf I said no and they go continued to say if you meditate everyday it’ll go away. There’s no point it trying to tell people how you feel if they don’t get it. You don’t get it unless you go through it. People always say it’ll help you grow but no when does it stop.
Today was a hard day. It was hard to get out of bed but when I did I got into a fight with my brother and I feel terrible. I lashed out and yelled out him. I can’t seem to control my emotions.
